lines: Me
「Oi, oiiiii?!! Una, why're you being chased by things like that?!!」
Una
「I don't knooowww～～～!!!」
Una
「I was running to try and get back to you all, when out of nowhere, they came from behind me～!!」
Trolls
「GOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!」
Me
「Ohhhh?!!! This is baaaaaad!!」
Chasing after Una, who had joined up with us, the trolls charged in.
Huge bodies, nearly three metres tall. Strong ferocity. Abnormal regeneration ability.
They were dangerous monsters with low intelligence, but more than enough power to make up for that.
Mai
「The skin colour of those trolls――They're the woodland race, I see. I've read about them in 『The Complete Guide to Demon World Species』.」
Mari
「Awawah......?! There's no time to be analyzing them, Mai-chan. They're coming, they're coming this way!!」
Me
「Kuh!」
Me
「Anyway, run away, everyone!! We can't be careless and fight in a place like this!」
Mari & Mai

「R-Roger!!」
「Understood.」
Even if we were students, we were four Taimanin.
These weren't enemies that we couldn't beat if we fought them, but――still, this was dead smack in the middle of a criminal city.
If we caused a commotion and got surrounded, it could result in a fatal situation.
Una
「Hieeeeeeeh?!! Don't come this waaaaayyyyyy!!」
Trolls
「GOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!」
Making savage war cries, the group of trolls attacked us.
We began a desperate getaway to shake them off.
Trolls

「Briefcase, money...... where......?」
「Where? That way......」
Making tremors, the trolls went past a back alley.
Me
「Phew. We managed to get through it somehow, huh?」
Mari
「I-I guess so......」
Mai
「I was frozen stiff.」
Una
「Heeeh...... I thought I'd died, like, three times......」
That back alley, after the trolls had passed by.
In a corner of that, a pile of abandoned garbage cans and scrap materials smoothly changed its form.
It was a concealment skill by Paper Spirit user Nanase Mai.

She had used countless pieces of paper to construct a small space, just large enough for the four of us to hide in, and made its exterior colour and texture mimic garbage cans and scrap to fool the eyes of the trolls.
Me
「Still, that's amazing...... You can even use a skill like that, Mai?」
Mai
「Yes. More or less anything, if it's a technique that uses paper.」
Mai
「Also, Sakura-sensei was telling us in class to prepare a few techniques we could use for escaping.」
Me
「That was sure the right call, wasn't it?」
Naturally, as was appropriate for an “exam mission”, we had put what we learned in class to use.
She usually came across as goofing around, but Sakura-sensei was surprisingly reliable.
Una
「Heeeeeh, thanks Mai-chaaaan! Awesome! You're the best!!」
Una
「You're my lifesaver～～!! I love you!! I adore yooooouuuuu!!」
Mai
「Wh-Whoa......! U-Um...... You don't have to go that......」
Una hugged Mai while hopping up and down.
Perhaps because the force of that was so extreme, the perpetually cool Mai was unusually flustered and blushing.
Mari
「I-Incidentally...... Fuuma-san, was that room just now all right? It wasn't too cramped......?」
Me
「Mmm? Why?」
And on the other side, for some reason, Mari was also making her cheeks red and looking bashful.
Mari
「W-Well...... Fuuma-san looked like he was cramped......」
Mari
「I've been eating too many dumplings lately, so...... I might have taken up extra space......」
Me
「Ah! No, no, I was fine! It wasn't like that at all, nope!」
Rather than that, I had just been desperate not to think anything untoward.
After all, the hiding space that Mai had made out of paper strips had been very confined.
And I had been hiding in a place like that, with my body pressed closely against these three――
Mari
「Huh......? Fuuma-san, why are you hunching forwar――」
Me
「A-Anyway......! We've given that bunch of trolls the slip, so let's try and sort out this situation!」
I told the three of them, to forcibly change the subject.
What actually was going on?
We were currently in the middle of an “exam mission” in the criminal city of Tokyo Kingdom.
That was just about over, when all of a sudden, Una had returned, being chased by trolls.
Me
「I'll check this one more time――Those guys appeared and started chasing you out of nowhere, right?」
Una
「Y-Yeah! I swear on tomorrow's breakfast carrots!」
Me
Going by what Una told us――

After completing her mission and escaping the BS Gang's hideout, she was hurrying to the rendezvous point, electing to use an inconspicuous back alley, when all of a sudden, that group of trolls had attacked her from behind.
Me
（So that means――）
The BS Gang had sicked pursuers on us......? The likelihood of that seemed low.
The orcs from before should have still been passed out in that abandoned building, and we hadn't heard of that organization having any other fighting force.
And there was one other thing that concerned me.
The trolls that were chasing us had been saying, 「Briefcase, money.」
That meant――
Me
「Una!! That briefcase is something that was in those guys' base, right?」
Una's mission was to steal the secret slave transaction ledger from the BS Gang's base.
But if she had taken something else besides that, the sort of thing that would cause some kind of uproar...
Una
「Eh? Yeah. I brought it 'cause it was in the safe with all sorts of papers and data.」
Me
「Let me see that a sec! ――Tch, of course it's locked.」
The briefcase was securely sealed by a lock which appeared to be made of an alloy.
Me
「Mai, could you use your paper to open this?」
Mai
「Well...... I don't think it would be easy.」
Mai
「Naturally, making movements precise enough to open the lock in a short amount of time...」
Me
「I see. It would be a bit of a problem to take our time right now, wouldn't it?」
We couldn't afford to take it slow in a situation where we were being hounded.
“What do we do, then?”――
Mari

「Ah! In that case, please hand it to me.
――Eih!」
Me
「Eh?」
――Bakiii!!!
Me
「Huh?」
Mai
「Wow!」
Una
「Hieh?!!」
Having placed her hand on the case, Mari put her strength behind it with a 「Hmph!」, at which point the alloy lock popped off, making a dull thud.
Mari
「Oh, I did it! It opened, Fuuma-san♪」
Me
「Y-Yeah...... Thanks...... Or I should say, you're unbelievable......」
I had heard that Mari possessed superhuman strength, but I didn't know she had this much power.
Mai
「Sure enough, I still can't live up to Mari-chan-senpai.」
Una
「Th-The King of All Beasts......!」
Mari
「Eheheh♪ I'm glad I could be of help!」
Me
「No, you really saved us, Mari! Now, let's cut to the chase――」
I checked inside the case.
And when I did, I immediately managed to find what I was looking for.
Me
「I knew it......... It's a tracking device.」
All Three
「Tracking device?!!」
Me
「Yeah. The trolls must've come chasing after Una, following this signal.」
This also explained why those guys had suddenly showed up chasing her.
Me
「Most likely...... someone probably put a bounty on it or something.」
The trolls had also been saying the word 「money」.
Had somebody put a bounty on the case and spread information about it, and us having it, to the dwellers of the underworld......?
Mari
「Th-That means...... the people from that organization just now......?」
Me
「Well, I don't know. I don't think those guys had the luxury of doing something like that......」
The main members of the BS Gang had been KOed by Mari and Mai.
And those at the base should have been in disarray due to the bomb that Una had planted, and in no condition to act properly.
Besides which――
Me
（What is this......?）
I couldn't help but cock my head.
There wasn't anything in the case related to trading slaves, which were the BS Gang's main commodity.
It was crammed full of a large number of ampoules, with strange liquid drugs in them――
Me
「No, we'll think about it later. Since a homing device has been planted, they'll find us here soon.」
I removed that from the case, and crushed it under my foot to destroy it.
But it looked like I was a little too late.
Demon Mercenaries

「There they are!! Over there!!」
「Slaughter those guys!!!」
Pursuing us, denizens of the underworld had appeared at the entrance to the alley.
